candidates.title: Exact equivalence of s-rectangular robust and risk-averse MDPs
candidates.description: Characterise when an s-rectangular uncertainty set induces the same optimal policy as a coherent risk measure on the transition kernel.
candidates.novelty_reason: p004 shows the sa-rectangular case; s-rectangular is open as far as searched.
candidates.difficulty_reason: New theorem with a duality proof; experiments are tabular (minutes on CPU).
candidates.impact_reason: Tells practitioners when robust and risk-averse training are interchangeable (Q1).
